risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (397.6), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising dollar pressuring multinationals, and credit stress evident; earnings in 37 days adds event risk to already hostile environment.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term overbought momentum (RSI, Stoch RSI, Williams %R) combined with supertrend bullish and force index cross-up suggests potential continuation if price holds above 88.94 support.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, rising dollar, credit stress), negative CMF distribution despite price strength, price below 50-SMA/EMA-50, Ichimoku below cloud, zero fundamental/insider support, and earnings event risk in 37 days create a hostile environment that overwhelms technical overbought signals.
